description: Discriminator: after a recovery commits the instance holding an admitted client operation as NOOP, does the owner's re-proposal carry the operation all the way to a client reply? Prefix: the harness admits the operation with the real client-proposal handler, delivers the NOOP commit, drains the re-proposed operation from the propose channel, runs the normal PreAccept/commit rounds with a peer through the real codec, and then applies the re-proposed instance with the real executor. Controls: the events print the pending count before the commit, whether a re-proposal appeared on the channel, the new instance's status at both replicas, and the bytes written to the client's reply writer.

harness.description: In-package Go test that drives admit, NOOP commit, re-propose, commit of the re-proposed instance and execution, reporting the client's reply bytes.
semantic_changes: harness-only scaffolding: two Replica values are constructed in-package with buffer peer writers; the handlers are unmodified and messages travel through the real codec
the client's reply writer is a harness buffer, so the observation is the bytes the implementation wrote

legality.derivation: Every step is the implementation's own: the client-proposal handler, the commit handler's re-proposal branch, the pre-accept and commit rounds, and the executor that answers the client.
legality.applicability: Owner-alive case, one operation, N=3 Thrifty.
unresolved: the peer is a second harness replica rather than a separately configured participant

grounding.derivation: The event reports whether the re-proposed instance executed and how many bytes reached the client's writer, which is the completion the client contract needs.
grounding.applicability: The operation was admitted and re-proposed, and the re-proposed instance committed.

observable_properties.description: An operation that a NOOP recovery forced the owner to re-propose must still be answered on the client's connection.

uncertainties: the harness supplies the client's reply writer, so it observes the bytes the implementation wrote rather than a socket
one operation and one re-proposal round are exercised
